title: 100-point 5-Pillar Specification Rubric (scored by the LLM spec-judge; validated by 02/scripts/validate_spec_scorecard.py)
scoringRules: Score every criterion 0..maxPoints. Any criterion awarded > 0 MUST quote verbatim evidence from specs/application_spec.md (the validator checks the quote is present, whitespace-normalised, case-insensitive). Separate several quotes with ' … '.
Criteria with 'appliesTo' not containing the project's inputScenario are not applicable: award maxPoints and set evidence to 'N/A — not applicable to <scenario>'.
A criterion marked blocking:true that scores 0 forces verdict FAIL regardless of the total.
Verdict is PASS iff totalScore >= 90 and no blocking criterion scored 0. Self-heal the spec (not the scorecard) until PASS.

pillars.title: User Experience & Zero Internal Data Leakage

criteria.title: Complete REQ-FUNC coverage of every discovered capability
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Every capability listed in specs/discovery_architecture_and_inventory.md §Capability Inventory maps to at least one REQ-FUNC-NN with a testable statement (actor, action, observable outcome). No capability is silently dropped or merged without a note.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote one REQ-FUNC line and the sentence/table that states capability coverage is complete (e.g. a coverage row or count).

criteria.title: Lifecycle state machine: diagram + transition table complete and evidenced
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: §3.3 has exactly one stateDiagram-v2 and a '| From | To | Trigger | Actor Role | Guard |' table that mirrors it; every transition names at least one actor role; terminal states are explicit; each state/transition cites its source evidence (legacy object or requirements paragraph) or an ASSUMPTION-NN.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote one full transition-table row and one evidence/assumption reference.

criteria.title: Business rules & formulas with inputs and sources
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: §3.4 lists every calculation, threshold, validation and derived value as BR-NN with an explicit formula (operators, units, rounding), the input fields it depends on, and the source document/clause. Each BR is referenced by at least one REQ.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote one BR table row containing a formula, its inputs and its source.

criteria.title: Scenario rule honoured (REQ-ENH present iff legacy; zero scope creep for requirements docs)
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: SCENARIO_LEGACY_APP: a '### 1.4 Modernization Enhancements' section with REQ-ENH-NN items each tied to a concrete legacy pain point. SCENARIO_REQUIREMENTS_DOC: no REQ-ENH section and every REQ traces to a requirement in the input document; nothing unsolicited is added.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the header line stating the Input Scenario and either one REQ-ENH item (legacy) or the statement that scope is strictly the input document (requirements doc).

criteria.title: Open questions and assumptions recorded explicitly
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Every workflow/rule ambiguity not resolved by inputs or the user at Gate 1 is listed as ASSUMPTION-NN with the chosen (most restrictive) reading and its impact, so it is visible and testable.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote one ASSUMPTION-NN line or the explicit statement that no assumptions were needed and why.

criteria.title: Authentication model defined
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: States how each role authenticates (e.g. SSO/OIDC for internal roles, account or verified-link for external roles), session lifetime, and what happens on expiry. Public/anonymous access, if any, is explicitly scoped.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the REQ-SEC item describing authentication per role.

criteria.title: RBAC matrix per role × transition / view
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: A table that, for every role in §3.5 and every trigger in §3.3, says allowed or denied; denied attempts return a user-readable message and are audited; external roles never see internal controls.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote one RBAC matrix row and the deny-behaviour sentence.

criteria.title: PII inventory and masking rules
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Lists each sensitive field (personal/tax/financial identifiers, contact data), its classification, where it may be displayed, the masking pattern at the presentation boundary, and retention.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote one PII inventory row including its masking pattern.

criteria.title: Encryption in transit and at rest
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: TLS for all transport; at-rest encryption for the datastore and uploaded documents; key management ownership named; secrets never in source.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the REQ-SEC item on encryption / key management.

criteria.title: Immutable audit trail of workflow actions
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Every state transition, role change and PII access writes an append-only audit record (who, what, when, from→to, reason); records are queryable by authorised internal roles only.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the REQ-SEC audit item listing the captured fields.

criteria.title: Colour contrast and non-colour status cues
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text/UI components); every status/severity is conveyed by text or icon, never colour alone.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the REQ-A11Y item stating the contrast ratio and non-colour rule.

criteria.title: Full keyboard operability
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: All interactive controls reachable and operable with keyboard in a logical order; no keyboard traps; custom widgets specify key handling; skip-to-content link.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the REQ-A11Y keyboard item.

criteria.title: Focus management and visible focus
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Visible focus indicator on every control; dialogs trap and restore focus; focus moves to the first error or confirmation after submit; route/view changes announce and move focus to the new heading.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the focus-management sentence(s).

criteria.title: Programmatic labels, names and roles
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Every input has a visible label bound via for/id or aria-labelledby; icon-only buttons have accessible names; landmarks (header/nav/main) and heading hierarchy are defined; tables have headers.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the REQ-A11Y labelling item.

criteria.title: Live regions for dynamic updates
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Status changes, live calculations and validation banners use aria-live/role=status or role=alert with polite vs assertive chosen deliberately.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the live-region requirement.

criteria.title: Error identification, description and suggestion
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Validation errors identify the field, describe the problem in plain language and state the concrete fix; errors are linked to the field (aria-describedby / aria-invalid) and summarised at the top.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the error-identification requirement.

criteria.title: End-to-end user journeys per role
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: For each role in §3.5 a numbered journey from entry to the role's terminal outcome, naming the views used and the state transitions performed; step count derives from the spec, not from a template.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the first step of one role's journey.

criteria.title: UX guardrails adopted or explicitly overridden
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: References _shared/ux_guardrails.md and lists any guardrail overridden by a design reference or Gate 1 instruction with the reason; no silent deviations.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the guardrail-adoption/override statement.

criteria.title: View & Component Topology table (§4.2) and design reference alignment
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: §4.2 contains a structured '| View ID | Navigation Tab / Route | UI Pattern | Bound Role(s) | Primary CTA & Lifecycle Trigger |' table defining every top-level tab/view, its interactive pattern (Wizard / Queue / Console / Registry), bound role(s), and primary transition trigger, enforcing mutual tab exclusivity and default-persona landing reachability. If resources/design_references/ (or reference_ui_manifest.json) exists, names the design references applied and accounts for every reference tab/view; otherwise states the default design system explicitly.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote one row of the §4.2 View & Component Topology table and the design-reference alignment statement.

criteria.title: Zero internal-data-leakage mandate with label mapping
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: References _shared/zero_leak.md, lists the token classes forbidden in visible text, and provides a human-label mapping for every state/trigger/error code in §3.3 (code → label) so the UI never renders raw codes, identifiers or engineering notes.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote one code→label mapping row and the leakage prohibition sentence.

criteria.title: Target stack alignment
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Architecture statements match specs/target_stack.json (frontend, backend, database kinds and run commands); no technology named that the stack does not include.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the sentence naming the frontend/backend/database kinds.

criteria.title: Normalised 3NF domain schema
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Entities in snake_case with primary keys, foreign keys and no repeating groups or derived columns; lookup/enum tables or constrained columns for status codes.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the 3NF requirement or one entity definition.

criteria.title: OpenAPI 3.1 contract requirement
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Requires an OpenAPI 3.1 document in design/solution_design.md covering one operation per state transition plus read endpoints; 4xx responses carry user-readable messages; transition endpoints validate (fromState, trigger, role).
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the REQ-ARCH item on the API contract.

criteria.title: ViewModel / DTO presentation boundary
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: A layer that converts persistence/API models into display models: codes → labels, PII masked, internal ids excluded; templates never bind to raw entities.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the ViewModel/DTO requirement.

criteria.title: Testability contract (stable data-testid hooks)
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: States that every interactive control and status display carries a stable data-testid declared by test/test_cases.json first (contract-first) and that ids are kebab-case and role/transition-named.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the testability requirement.

criteria.title: Traceability matrix completeness
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: specs/traceability_matrix.md maps every REQ id to its source (capability/requirement paragraph/legacy artefact), business rules and planned stories/tests; the spec references it.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the spec sentence referencing the traceability matrix.

criteria.title: No legacy carry-over (names, bridges, adapters)
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Explicitly forbids legacy table/form/report identifiers in target code and UI, dual-run bridges and compatibility adapters; migration is a one-time ETL described in design/data_migration_and_cutover.md.
criteria.evidenceHint: Quote the clean-migration prohibition sentence.
